headline: MOIL reports September manganese production at 1.81 lakh tonnes
hook: Output climbs on steady manganese demand
summary: State-owned MOIL announced provisional manganese ore production of 1.81 lakh tonnes for September 2026, marking an increase from 1.52 lakh tonnes produced in the same period last year. The higher output reflects strong operational volumes for the mining company during the month. For Indian retail investors holding MOIL shares, consistent volume growth indicates stable operational momentum. The company remains a key player to watch in the domestic mining sector.
why_it_matters: Higher production volumes point to steady operational earnings for MOIL.

headline: MOIL reports its monthly business update for September 2026 to the exchange
hook: September operational update from MOIL released
summary: State-owned manganese producer MOIL Limited has submitted its operational business updates for the month of September 2026 to the stock exchanges. These routine monthly production and sales figures allow retail investors to track volume trends and operational momentum at the company. Monitoring these disclosures helps gauge the demand for manganese from the domestic steel sector.
why_it_matters: Track monthly production volume to gauge underlying demand.

headline: MOIL hikes manganese ore prices by 5 percent for October
hook: Higher input costs for domestic alloy makers
summary: State-run mining company MOIL has increased prices of all grades of manganese ore by 5% effective October. Meanwhile, prices for electrolytic manganese dioxide remain unchanged compared to the previous month. The price revision impacts raw material costs for domestic alloy and steel manufacturers. Indian retail investors tracking metal sector input costs should note the margin implications for downstream producers.
whats_next: November price revision announcement by MOIL
why_it_matters: Higher raw material costs squeeze domestic alloy maker margins.
